speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been having trouble breathing and if your skin is turning blue?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity and maternal diabetes.

The baby was born preterm at 32 weeks and the mother had gestational diabetes; given the cesarean section, did you notice any meconium staining of the amniotic fluid, and is the baby currently showing signs of grunting or retractions?
